facets.label: Governance domain
facets.description: The branch or function of public governance whose activity the source primarily documents. Orthogonal to source_role (structure) and officiality (institutional status); a source may span several. Pruned to values that classify the profiled sources — market-operator is deferred (no RTO/ISO profiled yet).

values.label: Legislative
values.description: Legislatures, bills, statutes, and legislative tracking.

values.label: Regulatory
values.description: Executive-branch rulemaking: dockets, proposed and final rules, the regulatory agenda, and compliance/enforcement of rules.

values.label: Utility
values.description: Public utility commissions and utility-sector regulation and programs (rate cases, interconnection, resource planning, efficiency-program evaluation).

values.label: Judicial
values.description: Courts, litigation, and case law.

values.label: Standards
values.description: Codes and standards bodies: building energy codes, appliance and technical standards, certification.

values.label: Research
values.description: Research institutions, national laboratories, and registries of research outputs or research-data repositories.

values.label: Statistical
values.description: Official statistical agencies publishing primary datasets and time series.

values.label: Administrative
values.description: Executive/administrative agencies and their data infrastructure: facility registries, open-data catalogs, state energy-office networks.

values.label: Intergovernmental
values.description: Inter-governmental organizations' policy bodies and comparative policy databases (e.g. OECD, IEA).

facets.label: Energy sector
facets.description: Sector(s) of the energy system the source's material covers, for sources with a genuine sector focus. Sector-agnostic sources (general legislation, dockets, catalogs, research-data registries) omit it — their axis is governance_domain. Vocabulary pruned to values in use; seeded by the 0.2.0 free-string coverage.sectors.

values.label: Electricity
values.description: Power generation, transmission, distribution, and markets.

values.label: Buildings
values.description: Residential and commercial building energy use and decarbonization.

values.label: Industry
values.description: Industrial energy use and processes.

values.label: Transportation
values.description: Transportation energy and electrification.

values.label: Renewables
values.description: Renewable generation and clean-energy resources.

values.label: Oil & gas
values.description: Petroleum and natural-gas fuels.

facets.label: Policy lifecycle stage
facets.description: Lifecycle stage(s) of policy or regulation the source covers. Migrated from the 0.2.0 free-string coverage.policy_states; the planned-vs-effective split is exactly what routing sends to a source of record.

values.label: Introduced
values.description: Bill introduced or measure proposed in a legislature.

values.label: Planned
values.description: Announced or planned regulatory action not yet issued (e.g. the Unified Agenda).

values.label: Enacted
values.description: Passed/adopted into law or issued as a final rule.

values.label: Effective
values.description: In force on its effective date.

values.label: Failed
values.description: Died, was rejected, or failed to advance.

notes: Phase 5 facets, pruned to what the 30 energy profiles exercise. policy_instrument deferred (no data); governance_domain market-operator deferred (no RTO/ISO profiles yet). policy_stage 'planned' authored for the Unified Agenda.
